Event Element Stored: Announces that one Contour element (its record and declared outgoing relationships) has been created or updated and persisted. Reports a completed state change (past tense per Section 3.5).
Schema:
{
  "name": "string",
  "modelId": "uuid",
  "version": "integer",
  "storedAt": "timestamp",
  "elementId": "uuid",
  "elementType": "enum(System, Component, Function, Interface, Event, DataObject, Actor)"
}

Event Element Deleted: Announces that one previously stored Contour element, its record, and its relationships have been removed. Reports a completed state change (past tense per Section 3.5).
Schema:
{
  "modelId": "uuid",
  "deletedAt": "timestamp",
  "elementId": "uuid"
}

## Interface Contour REST API

REST/JSON API for creating, searching, retrieving, and rendering Contour specifications, worked at element granularity rather than as a whole submitted model. Primary contract of the system, designed to also back a future UI.

Schema:
./contour-engine.openapi.yaml

Exposes:
- Store Element (`contour_engine/engine.py`)
- Delete Element (`contour_engine/engine.py`)
- Store Requirement (`contour_engine/engine.py`)
- Delete Requirement (`contour_engine/engine.py`)
- Store Guardrail (`contour_engine/engine.py`)
- Delete Guardrail (`contour_engine/engine.py`)
- Search Specifications (`contour_engine/engine.py`)
- Retrieve Element (`contour_engine/engine.py`)
- Retrieve Requirement (`contour_engine/engine.py`)
- Retrieve Guardrail (`contour_engine/engine.py`)
- Render Diagram (`contour_engine/engine.py`)
- Search Requirements (`contour_engine/engine.py`)
- Search Guardrails (`contour_engine/engine.py`)
- Render Element Diagram (`contour_engine/engine.py`)

Requirements:
- Keep OpenAPI specification up-to-date: Model OpenAPI specification as a separate artifact in resources, keep it as a source of truth for code generation, keep it updated when change is requested. OpenAPI specification is a contract for external requests and responses.
mcp:
## Interface Contour MCP Server

Model Context Protocol interface exposing a read-and-store subset of the engine's capability to LLM/agent callers, over the same underlying Functions as the REST API.

Schema:
MCP tools map one-to-one onto engine Functions (search_specifications, search_requirements, search_guardrails, retrieve_element, delete_element, store_element, retrieve_requirement, delete_requirement, store_requirement, retrieve_guardrail, delete_guardrail, store_guardrail, render_diagram, render_element_diagram). MCP is a protocol, not a radar-listed runtime; see guardrail "Interfaces Share One Core".

Exposes:
- Store Element (`contour_engine/engine.py`)
- Delete Element (`contour_engine/engine.py`)
- Store Requirement (`contour_engine/engine.py`)
- Delete Requirement (`contour_engine/engine.py`)
- Store Guardrail (`contour_engine/engine.py`)
- Delete Guardrail (`contour_engine/engine.py`)
- Search Specifications (`contour_engine/engine.py`)
- Retrieve Element (`contour_engine/engine.py`)
- Retrieve Requirement (`contour_engine/engine.py`)
- Retrieve Guardrail (`contour_engine/engine.py`)
- Render Diagram (`contour_engine/engine.py`)
- Search Requirements (`contour_engine/engine.py`)
- Search Guardrails (`contour_engine/engine.py`)
- Render Element Diagram (`contour_engine/engine.py`)

Guardrails:
- Interfaces Share One Core: The MCP Server and the REST API must delegate to the same engine Functions and persistence. Neither interface may reimplement storage, search, or validation logic of its own; they are alternative front doors to one core. Any future UI must go through the REST API rather than the datastore.
